scope: One new three-bin finite mass-transport PVS entrypoint and its loaded Project/required original Native dependency closure. Incremental ordinary replay, not a whole-library replay or an implementation/physical refinement.

native_inputs.identity_encoding: Native name, relative source path/SHA256, relative proof path/SHA256, input-kind; repeated actual occurrences retained. Digest: SHA256 UTF8 compact JSON rows sorted by compact JSON encoding, ensure_ascii=false.
native_inputs.metadata_scope: Published 130 metadata slots in 44 files only; source statements and proof programs unchanged. Fresh external copy; installed libraries not modified. Actual required Native proof count above is determined by this entrypoint, with zero meaning none required.

algorithm.state_space: Three bins, arbitrary nonnegative real mass vectors, and a genuine 3x3 nonnegative coupling. Row and column sums define actual feasibility; examples have total mass one.
algorithm.concentration: The fraction is sum of three row maxima divided by total coupling mass, exactly; the zero-mass fraction is zero. With positive mass, fraction one is equivalent to every row being concentrated. Greatest-index row argmax breaks ties, including empty rows.
algorithm.generic_map_result: Feasibility and unit fraction imply pushforward compatibility of the extracted row-argmax map and hence existence of a deterministic map. An arbitrary row-maximizing candidate map is also compatible under those premises; no claim is made for arbitrary unrelated map selections.
algorithm.all_balanced_pair_coverage: The fully defined coupler uses a sparse pure-pair override, otherwise the product coupling for balanced pairs, and zero for unbalanced pairs. Its row/column marginals are proved for every balanced nonnegative mass pair, including zero mass.
algorithm.full_model: The selected map is (1,2,2) on the pure pair and otherwise a constant greatest target argmax. It is always nondecreasing. The finite log is exactly decoded by recover_map. The supplied exp, affine interpolation, computed concentration and L1 discrepancy satisfy every existing admissible_model? clause.
algorithm.pure_example: mu=(1/2,1/2,0), nu=(0,1/2,1/2), plan(0,1)=plan(1,2)=1/2, all other entries zero. Actual marginals, unit computed fraction, selected monotone map (1,2,2), compatibility and zero gap for every t in [0,1] are proved.
algorithm.split_example: mu=(1,0,0), nu=(1/2,1/2,0), plan(0,0)=plan(0,1)=1/2, all other entries zero. This is exactly the global coupler result, is feasible, has fraction 1/2, and no deterministic map has that pushforward. Actual L1 gap_at equals t, so midpoint gap is 1/2.
algorithm.scope_limits: Interpolation is affine mixing of mass vectors on a fixed grid, not McCann displacement interpolation. The score measures concentration of the chosen coupling; fraction below one does not generally rule out a different compatible deterministic map. No transport cost, optimality, Brenier theorem, Wasserstein tangent construction, numerical solver or physical controller refinement is established.
algorithm.unchanged_interface: The existing tangent_bundle.pvs/.prf and all other preexisting formal sources/proofs remain byte-unchanged.
